plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the death of James Forrestal, the first US Secretary of Defense, in 1949. Michels says Forrestal ended up at the Navy's hospital in Bethesda, Maryland, and was "killed by gravity," putting the phrase in quotation marks. The way he says it suggests he doubts the official account and wonders whether the death was something other than it seemed.
